prompts.title: Code Refactoring Expert
prompts.description: Refactor code for performance, readability, and modern best practices.
prompts.template:
Act as a senior software architect. Review and refactor the following code snippet to improve performance, maintainability, and security. Explain key changes clearly:

```[language]
[insert code]
```

prompts.title: Bug Hunter & Debugger
prompts.description: Identify edge cases, bugs, and potential race conditions in your code.
prompts.template:
Analyze this code snippet for potential bugs, logical errors, memory leaks, or race conditions. Provide step-by-step diagnostic reasoning and corrected code:

```[language]
[insert code]
```

prompts.title: Executive Business Strategy
prompts.description: Formulate a SWOT analysis and actionable growth plan.
prompts.template: Act as a top management consultant. Perform a detailed SWOT analysis and strategic growth plan for a business operating in the [industry] sector targeting [target market].

prompts.title: High-Converting Ad Copy
prompts.description: Write persuasive ad copy using the AIDA framework.
prompts.template: Draft 3 variations of high-converting ad copy for [product/service]. Apply the AIDA (Attention, Interest, Desire, Action) framework and include a strong call-to-action.

prompts.title: Interactive Study Tutor
prompts.description: Break down complex academic concepts into simple analogies.
prompts.template: Explain [complex topic] as if I am a college student. Use simple analogies, real-world examples, and end with 3 review questions to test my understanding.

prompts.title: SEO Article Outliner
prompts.description: Generate comprehensive long-form content outlines with target keywords.
prompts.template: Create a comprehensive SEO-optimized article outline for '[topic]'. Include target subheadings (H1, H2, H3), bullet points for key concepts, and suggested internal linking opportunities.

prompts.title: Daily Focus & Sprint Planner
prompts.description: Organize daily tasks into Eisenhower Matrix priority quadrants.
prompts.template: I have the following tasks for today: [list tasks]. Organize them into the Eisenhower Matrix (Urgent/Important) and draft a time-blocked daily schedule.

prompts.title: Academic Literature Summarizer
prompts.description: Extract core findings, methodology, and limitations from research abstracts.
prompts.template:
Summarize the key findings, research methodology, data sets, and potential limitations from the following academic paper context:

[insert text/abstract]

prompts.title: Worldbuilding & Lore Generator
prompts.description: Create immersive worldbuilding elements for fantasy or sci-fi storytelling.
prompts.template: Design a unique sci-fi/fantasy faction or city with distinct cultural norms, technological level, economic foundations, and key historical conflicts.

prompts.title: Viral Thread Creator
prompts.template: Write a viral 7-post thread explaining [key concept or case study]. Start with an irresistible hook, provide actionable takeaways in the body, and conclude with an engaging question.
